interface.name: zacos_snapshot_manager_v1

description.summary: read the last committed display frame

interface.description: Copies a displayed buffer without changing output render or cursor locks. Available to local Wayland clients, like the screencopy interface. Images exclude hardware cursors and are limited to 32 megapixels.

event.name: image

description.summary: read-only ARGB8888 image and logical display box

event.description: FD contains stride * height bytes, native-endian ARGB8888. Transform is wl_output.transform and must be applied to get displayed orientation. The image is sealed against modification. Close the FD after reading. Exactly one image or failed event is sent.
